reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only for RESOLVED. Listener, port and adapter match the interface. Adapter subject carries the reference. Listener swallows port failures. Build green, 5/5 acceptance, 55/55 existing tests.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) with catch-and-log. Port and adapter sit in the support/ticket port/adapter packages. Constructor injection via @RequiredArgsConstructor and the existing constructor. MockitoExtension unit tests were added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Clean event → listener → port → adapter chain, and the service never touches the adapter. EmailTicketNotificationAdapter hardcodes English subject and body with no locale, unlike EmailService's language-aware ticket mails.
reasons.test_quality: The service test asserts the captured event fields on RESOLVED and never() for other transitions and CLOSED. The listener test covers delegation and a thrown port failure. The adapter test captures recipient and subject. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support package files, SupportTicketService dependents and TESTED_BY links, and existing Event/Listener/Port/Adapter examples (InvoiceCreatedEventListener, FakturowniaAdapter). The agent read those examples before writing and mirrored them.
